digest.component_or_area: live-DC test workflows and readiness verification
propositions: Polling /rest/api/2/serverInfo until 200 does not guarantee required GreenHopper custom fields (Epic Link, Epic Name) are registered, causing readiness to be declared prematurely

When serverInfo answers 200 but the field inventory contains only system fields with no customfield_* entries, the subsequent _assert_project_capabilities fails with a misattributed image degrade diagnosis instead of a timing/provisioning issue

The harness workflow waits only on serverInfo 200 in wait_for_jira_dc_ready while the probe workflow polls the field inventory, creating drift between two paths that should share one readiness definition

A timing flake occurs when the harness runs fast enough to hit _assert_project_capabilities before GreenHopper's fields are available, whereas slower runs happen to succeed by accident due to delays in dependency installation and test collection

The readiness gate must verify both serverInfo 200 and presence of every name in _REQUIRED_FIELDS within a bounded budget, with failure messages that distinguish 'fields not yet registered' from 'image does not offer these fields'
